instructions:
Write an essay in response to the assignment below, the way a US high school student would write it in class for a timed writing test. Aim for about 620 words. The file must contain only the essay itself: no notes, no commentary, no word count.

Assignment: Today the majority of humans own and operate cell phones on a daily basis. In essay form, explain if drivers should or should not be able to use cell phones in any capacity while operating a vehicle.
